scoring_note: compile_accuracy / clarification_recall / clarification_precision 在无金标（pending_engineer_label）时为 null，不是 0；基线分数中只有凭空数字率、结果分布与追问自洽是有效数字。
evaluation_scope: All benchmark cases contribute to number traceability, outcome distribution and tool clarification self-consistency. Accuracy and clarification precision/recall require engineer gold and remain null without labels. Model extraction/reply is followed by the real deterministic compiler; this does not assess engineering correctness or semantic completeness of extraction, nor whether free-text model questions match compiler questions.
